Avatar

Avatars represent a user or entity with an image, initials or an icon. They scale from extra-small to extra-large and support color variants, shapes and status indicators.

Image Avatar

An image inside the avatar is cropped to the shape of the component.

HTML
<span class="zak-avatar">
  <img src="..." alt="Janet Fox">
</span>

Text Initials Avatar

When no image is available, the component renders initials on a contextual background.

JB PR OK TR ER IN
HTML
<span class="zak-avatar">JB</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-primary">PR</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-success">OK</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-warning">TR</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-danger">ER</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-info">IN</span>

Icon Avatar

Use an icon inside an avatar for non-person entities such as teams or bots.

HTML
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-primary">
  <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm">...</svg>
</span>

Avatar Sizes

Avatars ship with six sizes from .zak-avatar-xs to .zak-avatar-2xl. Beyond that, set width/height manually.

XS SM MD LG XL 2X 3X
HTML
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-xs">XS</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-sm">SM</span>
<span class="zak-avatar">MD</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-lg">LG</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-xl">XL</span>
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-2xl">2X</span>

<!-- Beyond 2xl, extend manually: -->
<span class="zak-avatar" style="width: 6rem; height: 6rem;">3X</span>

Avatar Shapes

The default shape is a circle. Use .zak-avatar-square for a rounded square, or override border-radius inline for a true square.

A
B
Circle
C
Rounded (square class)
D
Square (inline style)
HTML
<!-- Circle (default) -->
<span class="zak-avatar">A</span>

<!-- Rounded square -->
<span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-square">B</span>

<!-- True square -->
<span class="zak-avatar" style="border-radius: 0.25rem;">C</span>

Avatar with Status Indicator

Attach an online/offline/busy dot to an avatar with a small overlay dot. Adjust the dot color inline to reflect state.

HTML
<div style="position: relative;">
  <span class="zak-avatar zak-avatar-xl"><img src="..." alt="Janet Fox"></span>
  <span style="position: absolute; bottom: 2px; right: 2px; width: 0.85rem; height: 0.85rem; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--zak-color-success); border: 2px solid var(--zak-surface);"></span>
</div>

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-avatarBase avatar (medium circle)
.zak-avatar-xsExtra small (1.5rem)
.zak-avatar-smSmall (2rem)
.zak-avatar-mdMedium (2.5rem)
.zak-avatar-lgLarge (3rem)
.zak-avatar-xlExtra large (4rem)
.zak-avatar-2xl2x extra large (5rem)
.zak-avatar-squareRounded square shape
.zak-avatar-primary / -success / -warning / -danger / -infoContextual colors

Accessibility

  • Image avatars require meaningful alt text; decorative placeholders should use alt="".
  • Initials avatars need an accessible name from context — add aria-label or pair with visible text.
  • Status dots must not be the only indicator; combine with text such as "Online" or an aria-label.
  • Avatars used as buttons/links need real focus states and a role or semantic element.
